elements.text:
Boats, brass bands and
long tables on the quay.

Come early, the
first loaf is free.
Live on the roof, every Friday in July
Three stages and a bring your own blanket lawn

Nine songs for
the drive home
Rye toast, brown butter, a pickled cucumber.
A stack of three, whipped cream, maple.
Ham, cheddar, chives and home fries.
Open seven to three, Tuesday to Sunday
Cash or card. Dogs on the patio, please.

How to keep
a fern
happy
From the plant shop on Mill Street.
Bright but not direct. A north window is plenty.
Keep the soil as damp as a wrung out sponge. Lukewarm, from the bottom.
It will drop a few leaves in the first month. Wait it out, then pass this on to a friend.

A good
year on
the ground

of customers
came back within
the month.

Up from 51% last year, with the same
opening hours and the same two ovens.
Two batches an hour beat one big one. Less waste, warmer bread.
The seven o'clock crowd is the one that returns on Saturday.
A chalkboard with real numbers brought more people than any poster.

A second oven,
a longer table.

Long tables, loud speakers
and a grill that never stops.

From 14:00 until
the lights go out
